title: Continuation Integrity Result
description: Canonical attributable and integrity-protected result of Continuation Integrity processing for a nonterminal Governed Action Proposal before final Commit-Bound Admissibility is resolved. DS-039 verifies that the proposal-specific governance basis remains current, synchronized, and sufficiently qualified; evaluates material governance-condition changes and affected-proposal selection under active risk-based governance configuration; tracks Admissible Path Viability; records degradation, commitment suspension, governed re-evaluation, recovery, restoration, or terminal disposition; preserves Proposal Identity and governance lineage; and prevents prior authorization from being treated as unconditional future execution authority. It does not itself authorize execution, establish authority at commitment, bypass Commit-Bound Admissibility, or commit a transition.
